body:
## Context
`ghk doctor --api` on this repo (2026-08-26) established:
- `POST git/refs` for an existing ref returns **422 "Reference already exists"**, not 409. `src/lock.js` already classifies both as `held`.
- GraphQL `Issue.blockedBy`, `Issue.blocking`, `Issue.subIssues`, `Issue.closedByPullRequestsReferences` all exist.
- REST `GET /issues/{n}/dependencies/blocked_by` works with `X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2026-03-10`.

## What
- Update `skills/kanban/references/protocol.md` (claim row) and `README.md` (Status section, "How it maps" table) to state 422 as the observed duplicate response, keeping 409 as also-handled.
- In `docs/EVALUATION.md` §7 mark the "409 semantics" and "GraphQL blockedBy" items as VERIFIED with the date. Do not rewrite other sections.

## Done when
Docs are consistent with `src/lock.js` behaviour. No code changes.
title: Record verified API facts: duplicate ref create is 422, GraphQL fields confirmed
